title: Formalizing a direction toward shared generativity
request: continue with The remaining step, my proposed direction of reality is needs to be precise, and I think it can be formalized
scope: Descriptive direction of the coupled situation; operational capacity order, conditional statistical tendency, and shared-resource mechanism.

cross_session_contributions.capability_foundation: Joint implementable response profiles and separate plural requirements motivate a region rather than a scalar score.
cross_session_contributions.direction_research: Preserves the distinction between physical prevalence and normative standing; avoids treating longer survival as a universal widening law.
cross_session_contributions.concern_research: Inspected learning and evaluation distinctions; did not substitute a theory of caring for the requested descriptive direction.

claim_status.capability_order: Operational definition relative to assay functions, horizon and protected supports. Preorder on states; partial order on capacity regions.
claim_status.polytope_certificate: Exact inclusion certificate by linear-programming duality under stated bounded/nonempty/executable assumptions. No scientific-priority claim.
claim_status.stationary_direction: Proved sufficient ratio ordering for stationary stochastic dominance in a finite irreducible birth-death chain with valid ordered levels.
claim_status.strict_interpretation: Strict increase in the numeric level represents strict assessed-capacity improvement only with distinct strictly nested benchmark regions.
claim_status.transient_scope: Exact first-order counterexample shows stationary dominance need not hold at finite times from a common initial level.
claim_status.rate_scope: Transition rates supplied phenomenologically, not derived energetically or from the differential-equation model.
claim_status.restart: Positive formation from level0 is explicit; removing restart and keeping downward access makes eventual absorption at0.
claim_status.shared_model: Exact material/energy budget, rare-Y invasion exponent, and locally stable rational coexistence.
claim_status.connecting_trajectory: Numerical example checked at two step sizes, not a global basin proof.
claim_status.coexistence_scope: Additional compatible renewal is not proof of whole capability-set inclusion; resident throughput can decline.
claim_status.reciprocity_scope: Invader initial growth does not require contribution to recycling; positive recycling chemistry supplied.
claim_status.universal_status: A falsifiable comparative hypothesis and conditional theorems, not an established universal physical or moral law.
